reuse.why: Builds on the existing recurConfigToRSchedule rule builder and lets the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend pass weekdays through unchanged, with no new helper.

duplication.why: A single byDayOfWeek restriction is added; no logic is duplicated.

placement.why: The rule is expressed in the shared recurrence-rule builder in shared/schedules.ts, the layer every schedule consumer uses to generate occurrences.

scope.why: Only the daily branch, a focused test and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Skipping weekends by restricting the recurrence days is small, declarative and commented, so a maintainer can easily own it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Change lives in recurConfigToRSchedule, the existing abstraction.

one_place.where: recurConfigToRSchedule daily case in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; used by getNextDate (via Condition), server/schedules/app.ts, find-schedules.ts and rule-utils.ts.
